headline: Technical Project Manager
summary: I am a Technical Project Manager with close to a decade of experience in the agriculture, banking, fintech, staffing and IoT sectors. I have extensive experience in delivering products on the web, mobile, USSD and IoT platforms.
Recently, I revamped incoming and outgoing transfers, which brought a 3X increase in outgoing transactions revenue.

roles.title: Technical Project Manager
roles.description: Kopo Kopo is a Fintech company that provides services to move money and loans for SMEs. I work with the Head of Product to conduct market research, to come up with ideas that drive the product vision and strategy. I also work with the customer support team, data team and product marketing throughout the product development lifecycle.

projects.title: Move Money
projects.description: An improvement on how merchants receive and send money from their accounts through web, mobile and USSD.
projects.results: There was an increase of 80% in revenue after the feature was released.

projects.title: Free M-PESA
projects.description: Merchants get free transfers to a nominated mobile phone account on mobile web and USSD. This improved the merchant experience and created stickiness for merchants, reducing churn.
projects.results: The daily active users on the mobile app increased by 66%.

projects.title: Engineer onboarding
projects.description: I improved the engineer onboarding time by making changes to the onboarding process.
projects.results: Onboarding time went from 3 months to 3-4 weeks.

projects.title: Bug triage and security improvements
projects.description: Communicated with the IndeedFlex engineers to understand and address end-user challenges, security concerns and GDPR issues. Led stand-ups to triage bugs and unblock engineers, emphasizing secure coding practices. Decomposed bugs in Ruby on Rails and Kotlin apps, documented issues in Jira, and relayed tickets to Engineering Managers and Product Owners.
projects.results: Saved IndeedFlex 1000+ hours in development time, reduced negative customer feedback, and identified numerous security improvements.

projects.title: Rate card migration
projects.description: Worked with the rate card team to migrate thousands of employee rate cards to meet the new national minimum wage in the UK (2022).
projects.results: Over 100K workers were paid the correct wages in a timely fashion.

projects.title: PayPal withdrawals
projects.description: Led the development of a feature to connect merchants' Equity bank accounts to PayPal, allowing secure withdrawals from PayPal.
projects.results: The feature is used by over 10 million customers in East and Central Africa.

projects.title: Service degradation

projects.title: Western Union

projects.title: Congo app support
